name: You are my Sunshine
source:
High school student Sunny witnessed a murder and is now being blackmailed into keeping it a secret. She seeks to find a way out of this situation, but it doesn't help that the one blackmailing her is also obsessively in love with her.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211128222811/https://bloodpeach.itch.io/you-are-my-sunshine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中生桑妮目睹了一起謀殺，如今正遭人勒索，必須保守秘密。她努力尋找擺脫困境的方法，可那個威脅她的人，偏偏還對她抱有偏執的愛意，讓一切更加棘手。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211128222811/https://bloodpeach.itch.io/you-are-my-sunshine]Itch.io[/url]]
